thread:
sara_finance: Quick flag 17.9k embeds appear missing for Acme between 2026-03-04T00:00Z and 2026-03-06T23:59Z. Invoice INV-2026-03E posts tomorrow. Looks like connector-17 throttled and some events never made it through.

jon_sre: confirmed. connector-17 returned repeated 429/503 around 2026-03-05T01:30-03:10Z. Worker autoscaler bounced some pods, retries were dropped by old SDK version.

maria_data: pulled records from raw_events and deduped ingestion logs:
```
-- snippet
SELECT count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE customer='acme' AND source='connector-17' AND ts >= '2026-03-04' AND ts < '2026-03-07';
-- expected ~17900, found 0 for shards 12-14
```

lee_billing: if we backfill and bill, we need signoff. What19s the dollar impact?

maria_data: rough math: missing_count = 17,890. I initially used pricing per-1k at $0.065 -> calc was $1.16 (wrong unit). Our billing unit is per-embed at $0.0007. So 17,890 * 0.0007 = $12.523 => ~$12.52.

sara_finance: thanks for the clarity. So it's around $12.50. Small but we should correct invoice rather than leave it. Confirm we can run a backfill idempotently.

jon_sre: yes, we've patched SDK to mark backfill_run_id and added dedupe guard. Plan: run job backfill-acme-20260305-01 with flag --safe-dedupe. Command: `/infra jobs run backfill --connector connector-17 --from 2026-03-04 --to 2026-03-06 --customer acme --meta backfill_acme_20260305 --idempotent`. ETA 20m.

maria_data: also added reconciliation hook to ledger ingestion so newly inserted embeds are flagged as billable when backfill_run_id is present and not billed previously.

vik_manager: Approve issuing credit memo up to $100 and proceed with backfill. Please include a short customer note and link to postmortem.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-8002 for Acme, amount $12.52, linked to INV-2026-03E. Ticket FIN-2026-459 opened (connector-17 retry/drop bug).

jon_sre: backfill kicked off. Progress summary: shard 12: 5,930 inserted; shard 13: 5,960 inserted; shard 14: 5,995 inserted. total: 17,885 (delta -5).

maria_data: reconciliation job ran. Ledger updated, applied credit CM-8002. Invoice INV-2026-03E adjusted to reflect credit. Generated customer message draft.

lee_billing: confirmed ledger delta, credit applied. No downstream billing system errors. Notifying CS to send customer message.

sara_finance: customer notification sent: "We discovered an ingestion outage affecting March 4-6 and have applied a $12.52 credit to your March invoice. Apologies for the disruption."

vik_manager: please follow up with remediation: alert on SDK retry failures, upgrade connector fleet. Add to sprint.

billing-bot: FIN-2026-459 updated with postmortem: https://redwood.atl/FIN-2026-459/postmortem. Backfill job ID backfill-acme-20260305-01 stored in ticket.

sara_finance: closing loop here 14 backfill complete, credit memo issued, customer notified. :white_check_mark:
